left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Healthy male  [OR] and female subjects (aged 19~45 years at the time of screening)
  -  Subjects weighing  [AND] between 50kg (inclusive) and 90kg (exclusive), and having a body mass index (BMI) of 17

-  Subjects with a fasting plasma glucose (FPG) of 70～110mg/dL (inclusive of limits) at the time of screening
  -  Subjects who are willing to participate in the entire study cycle and comply with the study protocol (including contraception)

right.raw_text: Subjects who can sign the written Informed Consent Form after being informed of the study procedures

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Those with a history of allergies  [OR] including drug allergies (aspirin, [OR]  antibiotics, etc

right.raw_text: -  Those with diseases of the liver (including carriers of hepatitis virus), kidney, [OR]  respiratory system, [OR]  endocrine system, [OR]  nervous system  [OR] or immune system

left.raw_text: Those with a medical history of hematology/ [OR] oncology, [OR]  psychiatry  [OR] or cardiovascular diseases
-  Those with a medical history of gastrointestinal diseases  [OR] (ulcers, [OR]  Crohn's disease, etc

right.raw_text: ) or surgery (excluding simple appendectomy  [OR] or hernia repair), and these situations can affect the absorption of the study drug
